title: DOQS BOM sources sidecar
description: bom/sources.toml binds BOM rows to things that cannot live in bom.csv, which keeps its exact 16-column DOQS header. Two bindings: [[bind]] fills columns from a supplier length table, so adding a length model needs no BOM edit; [[vendor]] points a purchased component at its geometry.

id.description: BOM row id to fill, e.g. PRF-001.

table.description: Table path relative to bom/, e.g. tables/hgr20-rail.csv.

key.description: Parameter alias whose resolved value selects the table row.

match.description: exact refuses a length no supplier stocks. nearest-up buys the next stock length and records the cut in notes.

columns.description: BOM columns to fill from the matched table row.

id.description: BOM row id this geometry belongs to.

cad.description: Module-relative path to the supplier file. Omit for a length-dependent part: the bound table's `cad` column supplies one file per length.

envelope.description: Optional simplified solid used in assemblies; supplier originals are often unusably detailed.

terms.description: fetch-only files are gitignored; only their row in cad/vendor/vendor-index.csv is committed, and validation warns rather than fails when they are absent.
